title: Self-Pay Visit Package Terms — Visits Received by Transfer
content:
**Received visits are not passed on again.** Visits a Self-Pay Visit Package itself received from another patient by transfer are not passed on again: all of them where the latest transfer in was received no more than **120 calendar days** ago, half of them rounded up where it was received earlier, and none where the package received no transfer. The visits kept back are subtracted from the standing visits.

**Records read**

- The visit credits in the package history marked as received by transfer: their total visits, and the date of the latest of them.
- The calendar days from that latest date to the day of the transfer out.

**Table**

| Visits received by transfer | Latest transfer in received | Visits kept back |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | none |
| some | 120 days ago or less | all of them |
| some | more than 120 days ago | half of them, rounded up |

**Rounding examples (hypothetical, latest transfer in received more than 120 days ago)**

| Visits received by transfer | Half, rounded up |
|---|---|
| 1 | 1 |
| 4 | 2 |
| 5 | 3 |

**Boundary (hypothetical, 4 visits received):** latest transfer in 120 days ago — 4 kept back; 121 days ago — 2 kept back.
